danil.account.title: Danil account
danil.account.description: Sign in with your Danil account on this computer. The session belongs to the app, not to a workspace: no workspace joins the account until someone chooses it.
danil.account.name_hint: This is how this computer shows in your Danil account. It doesn't change your name in the account.
danil.account.pending_hint: The Danil page opened. If you don't see it, open it again.
danil.account.failed: Could not sign in to Danil.
danil.account.unavailable: The engine in this version of Danil cannot sign in to Danil yet. Update Danil.
danil.account.web_description: Your name and photo in Danil.
danil.account.photo_hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB. It changes the photo of your Danil account.
danil.connect.name_hint: This is how this computer shows in your Danil account. It doesn't change your name in the account.
danil.connect.invalid: This code does not exist or has expired. Go back to Danil and ask for a new one.
danil.connect.missing_code: The code is missing. Open the link Danil showed you.
danil.license.title: Request access to Danil
danil.license.body: For now, Danil on the web and the phone, machines, Harness and workspaces in Danil open account by account. Request access and we will write to you. Local agents on the desktop stay free.
danil.account.offline: Not connected to Danil right now.
danil.error.already_connected: That Danil account is already signed in on this computer.
danil.error.radiant_session_required: That workspace no longer has a Danil Teams session. Sign in with the browser.
danil.error.no_danil_account: That email has no Danil account. Sign in with another account in the browser.
danil.error.ambiguous_danil_account: That email belongs to more than one Danil account. Sign in with the browser to choose.
danil.error.license_required: Your Danil account has no license.
danil.error.email_not_verified: That email is not verified. Sign in with the browser.
danil.error.invalid_workos_token: That workspace's session expired. Sign in with the browser.
danil.error.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
danil.error.vault: Could not save the Danil credential on this computer.
danil.error.not_connected: This computer isn't signed in to Danil. Sign in first.
danil.error.image_too_large: The photo is larger than 2 MB. Pick a smaller one.
danil.error.unsupported_image: That photo isn't PNG, JPEG or WebP.
danil.error.unauthorized: Danil no longer accepts this computer's credential. Sign in again.
danil.error.account_conflict: This workspace already belongs to another Danil account.
danil.error.invalid_account: This workspace's Danil account is not valid.
danil.error.unsupported: Danil's server doesn't offer this yet.
danil.error.unavailable: Danil is not answering right now. Try again in a moment.
danil.status.expired_token: The code expired before it was confirmed. Sign in again.
danil.status.access_denied: The connection was declined in the browser.
danil.status.revoked: This computer was removed from your Danil account. Sign in again to reconnect it.
danil.status.revoke_unconfirmed: You were signed out here, but Danil did not confirm it removed the computer. Check your account.
danil.connect.used: This code was already used. If it wasn't you, check the computers in your account.
danil.connect.ambiguous: Your email belongs to more than one Danil account. Write to support and we'll help.
danil.connect.no_account: Your session does not match a Danil account.
danil.connect.denied: Done, it was not connected. You can close this page.
danil.footer.offline: {who} · not connected to Danil right now
danil.error.workspace_not_linked: This workspace is not connected to your Danil account.
danil.error.project_not_here: That project is a folder on another machine without a remote: its tasks only run there.
danil.error.workspace_exists: This machine already has a workspace with that id.
danil.error.invalid_workspace_id: That workspace id is not valid.
danil.error.workspace_not_found: That workspace is not in your Danil account.
danil.error.account_not_found: That account is no longer signed in on this computer. Sign in with it again.
danil.error.workspace_id_taken: This workspace still belongs to the other account. Sign in to that account on this computer to move it.

danil.accounts.sign_out_confirm.one: Signing out stops syncing its workspace on this computer. To remove just one workspace from the account, choose “No account” in Workspaces.
danil.accounts.sign_out_confirm.other: Signing out stops syncing its {count} workspaces on this computer. To remove just one from the account, choose “No account” in Workspaces.

danil.workspace.title: In the cloud
danil.workspace.unsynced_account: Not synced: {email} is not signed in on this computer.
danil.workspace.failed: Could not change this workspace's account.
danil.workspace.no_account: This workspace belongs to no account: it doesn't show on the web or the phone.
danil.workspace.leave_confirm: It leaves {email}: it stops showing on that account's web and phone. The account stays signed in for its other workspaces.
danil.here.title: This workspace: {name}
danil.credentials.remove_warning: Removing it from {machine} does not revoke it at {provider}. If that machine already had it, the key still works there: to really revoke it, change it at {provider}.
danil.credentials.delete_warning: It is deleted from your account and all your machines, but not revoked at {provider}: to stop it working, revoke it there.
danil.credentials.rotate.label: New key for {name}
danil.credentials.rotate.help: It is encrypted in this browser for each of your machines. Danil keeps the encrypted copies and cannot read them.
danil.credentials.rotate.no_webcrypto: This browser cannot encrypt the key. Change it from the desktop app or with an up-to-date browser.
danil.credentials.failed.unauthorized: Your Danil session expired. Sign in again.
danil.credentials.failed.license: Your Danil account has no active license.
danil.credentials.failed.offline: No connection to Danil. Try again.
danil.credentials.failed.other: Danil could not handle your account's keys. Try again.

danil.credentials.local.title.one: You have {count} key only on this machine. Upload it to your account?
danil.credentials.local.title.other: You have {count} keys only on this machine. Upload them to your account?

danil.credentials.local.title_on.one: You have {count} key only on {machine}. Upload it to your account?
danil.credentials.local.title_on.other: You have {count} keys only on {machine}. Upload them to your account?

danil.credentials.local.help: Choose which. They are encrypted for each of your machines and reach all of them; Danil cannot read them.
danil.credentials.failed.recipient: One of the machines is no longer linked to this workspace. Reopen Settings and try again.
danil.workspace.read_failed: Could not verify this workspace’s account.
danil.emails.title: Emails
danil.emails.description: Danil notices go to your primary email. Invitations to any of your confirmed emails reach you.
danil.emails.pending_hint: Enter the code we sent you.
danil.emails.add_hint: We'll send you a 6-digit code. The email counts once you confirm it.
danil.emails.code_prompt: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to {email}. It expires in 15 minutes.
danil.emails.spam_hint: Not arriving? Check spam or the promotions folder.
danil.emails.primary_confirm_hint: Danil notices will go to this email. If you sign in with a password or an email link, you'll use this email.
danil.emails.remove_confirm_hint: Invitations to this email will stop reaching you. If you sign in with Google or Microsoft with this email, that sign-in stays under «Sign-in».
danil.emails.primary_locked: The primary email can't be removed: choose another one first.
danil.emails.verified: You confirmed {email}. Invitations to that email now reach you.
danil.emails.empty: There are no emails in your account yet.
danil.emails.manage_description: Add other emails, choose your primary one and remove the ones you no longer use. Opens Danil in your browser, with the account you signed in with there.
danil.emails.error.code_invalid: That code doesn't match. Check it and try again.

danil.emails.error.code_invalid_left.one: That code doesn't match. You have {count} attempt left.
danil.emails.error.code_invalid_left.other: That code doesn't match. You have {count} attempts left.

danil.emails.error.code_expired: The code expired. Ask for a new one.
danil.emails.error.no_challenge: The code expired. Ask for a new one.
danil.emails.error.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts with this code. Ask for a new one.
danil.emails.error.rate_limited: You asked for too many codes. Wait a few minutes and try again.
danil.emails.error.email_in_use: {email} already belongs to another Danil account. If that account is yours too, write to support to merge them.
danil.emails.error.email_needs_support: {email} already has invitations or data in Danil. Write to support to add it to your account.
danil.emails.error.primary_email_taken: {email} can't be your primary: another account signs in with it. Write to support.
danil.emails.error.sso_user: Your company manages your primary email.
danil.emails.error.primary_is_danil: Your @danil.ai email is always your primary.
danil.emails.error.already_verified: That email is already on your list.
danil.emails.error.too_many_emails: You reached the maximum number of emails. Remove one to add another.
danil.emails.error.email_is_primary: The primary email can't be removed: choose another one first.
danil.emails.error.email_used_by_login: {email} is used to sign in with Google or Microsoft. Disconnect that sign-in under «Sign-in» to remove it.
danil.emails.error.email_send_failed: We couldn't send the code. Try again in a minute.
danil.emails.error.email_codes_unavailab: Adding emails isn't available right now.
danil.emails.error.generic: The change couldn't be completed. Try again.

danil.secrets.no_recipients: None of your machines supports secrets yet, so there's nowhere to deliver it. Update Danil on one of them and try again.
